takeaway: Composition should survive decoration refresh, highlighted text, multi-node spans, and widgets beside the composing node.
Arrow motion should enter/select and leave inline atom positions predictably from both sides.
Decorations spanning inside an inline node and into following text must project without boundary corruption.
Node selections should serialize only the selected node and parse back as the same slice.
Composition and beforeinput ownership depends on token/segmented nodes, dirty text, and DOM selection target agreement.
Mention entity exports/imports as a span, blocks text before/after, and uses segmented directionless text mode.
New contract proves Editable decorations split correctly across an inline element boundary.
